I know how difficult it can be to find work when you’re just starting out in Israel, so I wanted to share this here in case it can help someone.
I know how difficult it can be to find work when you’re just starting out in Israel, so I wanted to share this here in case it can help someone.

My partner and I run an English speaking kindergarten in the heart of Tel Aviv, and we’re currently looking for warm, responsible, and motivated people to join our team for the upcoming school year (with the option to start earlier as well).

Several people on our team are currently going through, or have already completed, the immigration and citizenship process themselves, so we understand the challenges that can come with starting a new life here.

If you enjoy working with children and are looking for a positive place to grow and stay long term, feel free to reach out to me privately for more details.
